name: @metorial/orcarouter
description: Route chat completions, Responses API calls, and embeddings through OrcaRouter's OpenAI-compatible gateway, which fronts many model vendors behind one endpoint. Discover the live model catalog with capability and input-modality filters, read per-model context and pricing metadata, and connect either with an existing OrcaRouter API key or with an OAuth 2.0 + PKCE browser login that issues a key billed to the user's own account.
